"and"; the custodian's key keeps that line as ONE lesson named by its first head (the tail is ignored, never runs out, never doubled), the
wide reader's v3 rule (cut at a separator only where a new amount begins) reads TWO ingredients; the second is never taught, so the brain
asks, names it, and does not guess. Across all 128 items this shape appears exactly twice — the two asks — and on no answered item. A HELM rule
that merged the second amount would be a special case that breaks ordinary lists; the general fix is the custodian's `representable()` rule
refusing a raw line with more than one quantity span (`MULTI_QTY`), an instrument amendment (A-R1W7-7) for a fresh draw only (the sealed c54
data may not be re-read). **Result 2 (MEASURED):** every one of the 32 clause-bearing dialogue items of c54 ends `CLARIFY UNREAD_CLAUSE` in the
wide reader and an ingredient refusal in the licensed one, so no stock is recorded and the question asks (S1 6, S2 6, S6 2, S7 4 scored
UNDETERMINED; S3/S4/S5 14 RIGHT only because an ask is an ask). The face reader `helm_faces_in` v1 reads the generator's own forms when the
name is an everyday word, but its name table is hard-wired to 8 ingredient words and 3 product words; with the name slot left open its 31
lexicon rows match 28 of 28 S1–S6 clauses of c54 and 0 of 4 S7 clauses. Wave-6 readings c48 and c50 show the same four families undetermined:
structural, not a draw. The R4 paraphrase (2 of 64) is `NOT_MINE` because `WITNESS_RX` admits no leading time phrase and `END_RX` no "the X ran
out first" form. A fourth gap is sized but not designed: 15 of 128 real recipes lose every lesson to units outside the 20-unit table.
**Design (PROPOSED, hashed before code):** D1 clause split in the wide reader (stock recorded, clause carried); D2 the face reader takes the
names it is given (default byte-identical); D3 the wide path stores faces under wide names in the triad table, ignores a no-cue clause with a
trace, asks on an unreadable one; D4 the wide question applies η = min of the three face values (reusing `helm_triad`), recipe Purpose absent
→ ask, ingredient Purpose absent → yield 0 → ask; D5 the past-tense lesson paraphrase; D6 the custodian's `MULTI_QTY` rule (owner's word);
D7 units outside the table: OPEN. Six test groups on the author's own sentences. **Nothing is licensed by this section; no code changed; the
licensed brain, the lexicon and the K4 rule are untouched.**

### 7.110 HELM talk packet v1 (design only, 0 USD): normal conversation designed as three layers — ears (the CTT retrained, with `NOTHING_TO_SAVE` as a first-class output, called only where the hand-written reader asks, three-copy vote, ask by default), brain (the wide recipe brain, untouched) and mouth (the voice guarding every reply: no CAS token, no recipe-speak on non-recipe turns, exact amounts, honest unknowns) — with a human-written exam (K-H: four named writers, floors 16 per kind × 7 kinds, keyed by the writers, never pasted into a model) because public text has almost no stock statements (§7.94); a 30-line keyword rule as the cheap threat the ears must beat; two owner lines proposed, `TALK TRAIN at 3 USD` and `TALK EXAM at 1 USD`; NOTHING BUILT, NOTHING TRAINED, NOTHING RUN, NOTHING LICENSED; §7.109 (PR #433) is the hand-written reader's half, not redone here (2026-10-21 PDT, laptop, 0 USD)

**Said plainly first.** The owner ordered a "talk packet" after asking about normal conversation, and said what the CTT was for: "THE CTT ... WAS BUILT TO GIVE HELM THE ABILITY TO HAVE NORMAL CONVERSATIONS WITHOUT SOUNDING LIKE IT WAS GIVING RECIPES ALL THE ... TIME". This section records a **design** and nothing else. HELM's brain stays the recipe brain. The ears (the CAS-token transformer, 9,585,566 parameters, §7.82) read what a person typed where HELM's hand-written reader cannot, propose a reading only when their three copies agree, and ask before anything is used; they get one new output, `NOTHING_TO_SAVE`, so that on a greeting they can be silent on purpose instead of silent by failure. The mouth (the voice, `helm_voice.py`) guards every reply, recipe or not. The blocker is data: an exam of people typing to HELM cannot be drawn from public text (15 first-person stock statements in 863,598 sentences, §7.94; CTT-2R's census found 7 against a floor of 24, §7.95), and the templated dialogue generator cannot test it (every turn is a template). So the exam is typed by named people for HELM, at 0 USD, keyed by the writers, pinned and held by the custodian, never shown to any model. The hand-written reader's half of the same problem (purpose clauses, feelings, past-tense paraphrases: a name-table change, not a new grammar, measured 28 of 28 face clauses fit by the existing 31 lexicon rows) is §7.109's D1–D7, ordered built by the owner on `claude/helm-reader-gap-build-20261021`; this packet names it and does not redo it. No code was written. No run happened. No claim moved.

mode the name slot allows up to three words before a given name, greedy so the head noun wins, and the captured phrase is resolved to the held
name (`_names_in`; two held names inside → `FACE_WHICH_INGREDIENT`); a two-word name is matched with a hyphen or a space either way. (F2) a
clause the face reader cannot read withdraws the amount of the ingredient it names from the wide stock (v4's own `_withdraw_mentioned_stock`,
now applied to the clause and using the same name forms), on the wide path and on the licensed-recorded path alike, so the next question asks
for that amount instead of answering; the pending-ask mechanism of v7 is removed. **Result on the four:** CV32 3/8, CV33 1/6, CV34 1/4, CV37
3/16 — the key's yields — with the stated face applied (η 1/2 or 1/4 on the named ingredient). `ENGINEERED-NOT-VALIDATED`; nothing licensed.

per-item replay (names hashed, §7.116 "Mechanism") found three holes in the reader, not three accidents: (1) the face reader, given a clause

the raw yield; (2) one of those clauses named a held ingredient by a plural/spelling form the name matcher did not reach; (3) in one lesson a
measure phrase after a separator ("…, a dash of X") was folded into the line before it as a note, and X's running-out was then resolved onto
that line's ingredient, so the brain learned a wrong amount (factor 24 off). v7.2 closes each with a general rule, written as tests first (FIX
FIRST): the 7 new tests were run against the v7.1 reader (`Ran 7 … FAILED (failures=5)`; the 2 that already passed pin behaviour that must not
change) and pass on v7.2. The replay of c55's three faults under v7.2, by program on the hashed units: the S2 item now returns

the question returns `CLARIFY_WIDE_INGREDIENT_PURPOSE_ABSENT` (the ask the key wanted); the lesson sentence's "a dash of X" is its own line, its
running-out resolves to no other line, and the sentence is refused instead of written. The six v7.1 practice items keep the key's own numbers
(3/8, 1/6, 1/4, 5/8, 2/3, 3/16). **Nothing is measured on a sealed draw here and nothing is licensed**; the next sealed draw needs a v9 reseal
(the forked session's process, §7.114) on the merged head and the owner's own typed line.

## 8. THE TWO CLAIMS

### 8.1 CLAIM A — "the weights are natively CAS" — **DEAD**

**The claim:** CAS structure is latently encoded in activations and recoverable by correlational probing beyond surface. CAS is the shape the model already thinks in.

**Status: DEAD.** Killed by four converging, independently pre-registered negatives on real GPT-NeoX-20B captures, and **formally retired by the owner on 2026-08-18**.

1. Flat 40-cell detection **collapses to chance** under leakage control (**6.5%** vs **2.5%**; scrambled labels ≈ real; on F28 shuffled **beat** real).
2. MTC Condition-3, the first blind matched comparator, returned **`GREY`** — a cardinality-matched non-CAS taxonomy was **~13× more recoverable** on the same rows and same activations (**0.8472** vs **0.0653**).
3. Involution relational structure **DISCONFIRMED** — CAS's pairing is the **LEAST antipodal of 15 on all 43 real layers**, centroid cosine **POSITIVE +0.32..+0.61**.
4. Domain precedence is **present but confounded** with a generic abstract-to-concrete gradient (strict fit ranks CAS **2/12** even at its best layer).

**State the scope precisely so the negative is not over-read.** What is dead is *"CAS is latently encoded in the weights, recoverable by correlational probing beyond surface."* What is **NOT** dead: the harness demonstrably reads structure, that structure is causally load-bearing, and it conditions next-token behaviour — all `LICENSED` up to 20B. **What died is the SPECIFICITY and NATIVENESS of that structure to CAS.** The evidence is trending toward *"CAS structure is not distinctly present in the model beyond generic topical structure."* **Report this plainly. Do not spin it. Do not revive Claim A in any external document.**

### 8.2 CLAIM B — "CAS is a measurement and correction language" — **LIVE**

**The claim:** CAS does not have to be the shape inside the weights. **The ruler need not be inside the table.** It has to be (i) a reliable way to READ what a model produced, and (ii) a working algebra to CORRECT it.

**Status: LIVE THESIS — ratified by the owner 2026-08-18.** Two-part bar; **both parts have positive evidence; neither is closed.**

**Bar part 1 — reliable, non-arbitrary translation.** L1 reader-to-reader **0.8845** (Fleiss **0.88**) vs thesaurus **0.2841** on clean exemplars. On **real** outputs the thesaurus falls to **exactly chance (0.025)** while readers still hold **0.5333**. WIRING agreement runs at **`0.2437 / 0.0525 = 4.642×`** chance (edge Jaccard **0.2437** vs null **0.0525**; **exact, corrected 2026-08-19 from "≈4.7×"**), and main-part agreement **0.6200** (kappa **0.5489**) **beats** single-cell **0.5333** (kappa **0.4479**).

**Bar part 2 — the algebra does real work.** The RPM compiler loop ran end-to-end on real modules (`exit 0`, nothing stubbed): translate → inject → **detect ON THE NAMED AXIS** → correct → round-trip. Axis-A resistance **1.0000 → 0.8571 → 1.0000**; axis-N `flagged_pairs=[(2, 3)]` with a full involutive round trip. Supporting: the behavioural proxy loop shows targeted repair (**7.19**) beats generic repair (**4.59**) with **75%** localization; validated steering levers exist (η→ε realization to **+1.412050** at 20B; drive-local eraser steering **+0.84** at `p < 1e-14`). **Strengthened 2026-08-19 by WELD v2 (Cap. 37), which is the first result in this half that CAN FAIL and is measured against a chance rate a random guess actually hits:** six cases, **three designed to fail and failing**, `LOOP_FALSIFIABLE_AND_HELD`, control `1/7 = 0.142857` exhaustive and **0.149000** empirical over 2000 draws, `repaired != original` measured (`L1 0.10 / 0.20 / 2.25`), and a tamper check in which the same case reports `False` driven by the localizer and `True` driven by ground truth. **Weigh it correctly: this is ONE axis on the numeric plane with no model loaded, and its own author writes that "no arrangement of this detector can produce a result that is surprising in principle."** The advance is falsifiability and chaining, not reach. **And read it beside the WELD v1 record (§7.17), where four criteria out of four could not return `False`** — the same track produced both.

**What Claim B rests on, and what it does not.** Its value rests **entirely** on the lens being reliable and non-arbitrary, and **not** on any claim that the number lives in the weights. **Every number in the underlying manuals is a design score or an observed rating, never a voltmeter reading from a model.**

**Outstanding gaps against the bar — updated 2026-08-19, and the update runs in both directions:**
1. The sharpest anti-thesaurus discriminator (**L3 matched-surface pairs**) has **not been validly run** — the fixture let the thesaurus split the pairs at **0.857** against readers' **0.893**.
2. Real-output agreement is **moderate** (**0.5333** single-cell, ~**24%** edge overlap) and its coverage figures are **optimistic**.
3. The algebra covers **4 of 7** axes at string level, with **no auto-repair dispatcher** — **now narrowed, not removed: a real dispatcher exists for axis `A` on the NUMERIC plane (Cap. 37), and for every other axis and the whole string plane this gap stands verbatim.** And the string-level count is now known to have been **worse than 4 of 7 in practice** on drive-tagged expressions until commit `f799fe98`, because axis `W` could not fire (§7.18).
4. **THE WELD** — diagnosed axis → corrected notation → live steering lever, run as one machine — **is still the remaining build, but half of it now exists. The links exist; the weld does not — that sentence still holds for the machine as a whole, and only for the machine as a whole.** WELD v2 welds **INJECT → blind GATE → blind LOCALIZE → chained REPAIR → blind VERIFY** on one axis, with a real non-zero chance null a random intervention hits about **1 time in 7**, and a tamper check proving the chain is load-bearing rather than decorative. **What is still absent is the model-facing half:** `J1` (text reading → CAS), `J2` (expression → epsilon prefix), the return leg, and Stage 5 (any measurement on a model). **No efficacy claim exists anywhere in the weld track.**
5. **NEW, and it cuts at the lens rather than the algebra: the sequential reading track came back empty (§7.14, §7.16).** Asked what comes next, the lens lost to "predict no change" and fell below its own permutation null. Asked when the kind of response changes, the run went `VACUOUS` — and the reason it went `VACUOUS` is that **the six-code board taxonomy resolved to TWO live categories on natural conversation** (`B0 115`, `B3 40`, `B2 1`, `B5 1`; `B1` and `B4` never reached consensus; `B0` share **0.7325** against a **0.40** ceiling). **Claim B's part 1 — reliable, non-arbitrary translation — is evidenced on SINGLE outputs and is NOT evidenced across a conversation. Say which one you mean.**

**And the honest part:** the discipline here — pre-registered thresholds locked before data runs, matched controls as the primary comparison, scrambled-label and no-model lexical nulls in every fixture, reject-not-repair on gate failure, early-kill to avoid spend, and reserved claim-status language — **is what makes Claim B credible, and it is the same discipline that produced every negative in Section 7.**

### 8.3 The permanent honesty ceiling

Carried from all four source manuals, and binding on every future edit:

> **Every CAS number is a design score or an observed rating, NEVER a voltmeter reading from a brain or a language model. The residual proves flow CONSISTENCY, not semantic CORRECTNESS.**

> **Steering is licensed only to close a measured Δ-I on a DETECTED fault, and stops when closed. "Flexibility becomes manipulation when the knob has no stops."**

> **Aggregate metrics never get to be the audit** — a healthy parent total can mask an overloaded branch and a starved branch that cancel out.

### 9.2 File transfer through the SSH-proxy PTY — `VALIDATED`

There is no `scp`. You paste the file through the interactive terminal as tagged text and check the fingerprint on both sides.

- **Send:** gzip/tar the file → `base64 -w 64` → prefix **every line with `@@`** → paste inside a heredoc. On the pod: strip the `@@`, `base64 -d`, `gunzip`.
- **Receive:** same tagging on the pod, then locally extract with **`grep -o '@@[A-Za-z0-9+/=]*'`** — **NOT `grep '^@@'`, because the first line hides behind the shell prompt** — then **drop every fragment shorter than 20 characters** (the PTY injects 1-char fragments), then `base64 -d | gunzip`.
- **Always verify sha256 on both ends before trusting the copy.**
- **Track record:** carried a 273 KB script **in** and three artifact sets **out**, with sha256 equality every time. Bridge recovery decoded **23255/23255** bytes.
- **Second footgun:** local Python cannot read Git-Bash `/tmp/...` paths on this Windows host — **write the reassembled file to a real Windows path.** The helper used for the bridge recovery (`scratchpad/extract_tgz.py`) is scratch, **not in-repo** — re-derive it from the runbook recipe rather than hunting for it.
- **Artifact:** `docs/working/gate2_closure/component_atlas_v0/RUNBOOK_POD.md:69-75`.

**Treat this as the default, and always sweep a pod for single-copy artifacts BEFORE requesting termination.**

### 9.3 Fresh-pod bootstrap — `bootstrap_20b_pod.sh` — `VALIDATED`

One paste, idempotent, safe to re-run after a disconnect. It encodes every failure already paid for, in order:

0. **Prove the disk is really writable by actually writing 1 GB** — a network filesystem reports a huge "available" figure while a per-pod **quota** still refuses writes. **`df` lies, `dd` does not.** `dd bs=1M count=1024` to `$WS/.quota_probe`, FATAL + `exit 1` on failure.
1. Build a venv, then run **`python -m ensurepip --upgrade`** — the rented venv had **no pip at all**.
2. Install `torch`/`transformers`/`numpy`/`scikit-learn`/`huggingface_hub`/`accelerate` — **sklearn was missing too**.
3. Export **`HF_HUB_CACHE`** (**not `HF_HOME` alone**) — the model cache layout is **flat**, and `HF_HOME` makes the loader look in `$HF_HOME/hub` and miss every cached model.
4. Download the model detached under `setsid ... </dev/null` with `disown` so it survives the SSH session dying. **`max_workers=3`** with retries — 8 workers against an unauthenticated rate limit wedged the first attempt.
5. **Print the resolved snapshot commit, which MUST be recorded as the revision pin.**

**Numbers:** sha256 of `bootstrap_20b_pod.sh` = `3e5e2b1e2c7a3b0683ade7f328725f2f97ed1c64a85c345cdec7d1d907b6e026`. `NEED_GB=60`. Downloader: `max_workers=3`, `etag_timeout=60`, `HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT=60`, `HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=0`, **40** retry attempts with backoff `sleep min(20, 3*attempt)`. Paths: `WS=/workspace`, `CACHE=/workspace/cas-hf-cache`, `VENV=/workspace/atlas-venv`, `RUN=/workspace/cas-atlas-v0`. Env is also written to `~/.bashrc` so it survives reconnects.

### 9.4 Hardware sizing — the GPU decides whether the bf16 compromise survives

| Card | Memory | fp32 20B verdict |
|---|---|---|
| A40 | 46 GB (**44.99 GiB** usable) | **impossible** |
| A100 / H100 | 80 GiB | **96% of card** — OOM once activations land; **bf16 only** |
| **H200** | **141 GiB** (**139.8 GiB** observed) | **fp32 fits, ~63 GiB spare** |

- 20B **fp32 = 76.6 GiB** required. **MEASURED on the H200:** `max_memory_allocated_gib 76.57173252105713` after load; peak **76.97243785858154** allocated / **77.224609375** reserved. 20B **bf16 = 38.3 GiB**.
- **Disk ≥ 120 GB** (20B ~41G + pythia-2.8b 5.4G + blobs + outputs). The A40 pod died at **52G** with ~**15.4G** freeable against ~**18G** required.
- Model read from a network volume: budget **3-8 min** for 38.4 GiB (~1 min from local NVMe). Full fp32 20B run: **4035.0 s**.
- The bootstrap prints its own fit verdict: `FITS` only if `gib > 80` for fp32, `gib > 42` for bf16.
- **Why it mattered:** the H200 let the bf16 deviation **D33** and its calibration precondition **D34** be **withdrawn outright (as D57)** instead of carried forever as a precision caveat on every result.

**Caveat:** **free HOST RAM matters too, not just VRAM** — `accelerate` buffers one shard at a time even with `device_map={"":0}`. And **renting a bigger card is not free of process**: moving bf16 → fp32 is a **deviation reduction** and still had to be logged in the prereg **before** the run, with a dated entry saying the resource constraint no longer applies.

The harness advances along a numbered ladder from **0.33 to 1.00**; a score is awarded only when the named exit evidence passes.

`current 0.33` → **Gate 1 +0.05 = 0.38** → **Gate 2 +0.08 = 0.46** → **Gate 3 +0.10 = 0.56** → **Gate 4 +0.09 = 0.65** → **Gate 5 +0.10 = 0.75** → **Gate 6 +0.10 = 0.85** → **Gate 7 +0.10 = 0.95** → **Gate 8 +0.05 = 1.00**.

Dependency: Gate 1 → 2 → 3 → 4; Gate 1 also forks to 6A (→ Gate 5 100B rehearsal / 300B run), 6B, and 7 in parallel; Gates 2-7 → Gate 8.

- **Gate 1 EARNED 2026-07-24** by Attempt 11, receiver-confirmed, commit `f95cc610`, score commit `194fec39`.

- **Gate 4** minimum named family coverage: Pythia/GPT-NeoX, Qwen, OLMo, Llama-or-Mistral, plus one small MoE.

### 9.7 Atlas run order on a pod — preflight FIRST, preregistered, never reordered

1. **Check the model cache** is real safetensors and **resolve the exact commit to pin.** The script hard-aborts as `ABORT_UNPINNED_REVISION` without one and `ABORT_CACHE_FORMAT` on a bad cache — but the 5-minute manual check is cheaper than discovering it after a model load.
2. **Smoke** — mechanical validation only. **Smoke numbers are NEVER evidence.** (89.2 s.)
3. **Behavioural preflight** — reads no test statistic, so it cannot be tuned toward a pass.
4. **Only if the preflight says go**, launch the confirmatory battery.

Everything runs under `nohup` with the report **flushed at every stage boundary**, so a late crash keeps everything up to that point.

**Required env:** `HF_HUB_CACHE=/workspace/cas-hf-cache`, `HF_HOME` same, `TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false`, `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True`.

## 10. OPEN FRONTIERS — RANKED, WITH WHAT WOULD SETTLE EACH

Ranked by how much each one unblocks. **"Would settle it" means a pre-registered criterion, matched controls, and an artifact path — not an argument.**

**1. CAS-SPECIFICITY — the whole frontier.**
Every closed tier establishes that the model linearly encodes whatever distinctions the CAS labels track, and that the encoding is causally load-bearing on at least one model point. **None of it distinguishes that from one coherent relabeling of generic semantic structure.** Detection is the licensed core; comparative and probabilistic speciality are `OPEN`; absolute uniqueness is explicitly disclaimed and is not the target.
**Would settle it:** ONE clean blind matched-comparator **WIN** — a cardinality-matched non-CAS taxonomy doing measurably **worse** than CAS on the same activations, at the pre-registered margin. This has never occurred.
**The single most available lever:** an **MTC-style matched non-CAS four-level abstractness taxonomy run against the domain axis** on the same fixtures. Domain precedence is the last surviving CAS relation; if a generic abstractness taxonomy does **not** do worse, that relation also folds into the generic explanation. **The machinery exists (`arm_E_non_tks_ontology.json`).** **RAN 2026-08-22, pre-registered, `$0` — disposition `INCONCLUSIVE BY DESIGN` (§7.19):** the activation-probe instrument is invariant under any bijective class relabeling, so ANY matched taxonomy assigned by a fixed bijection ties CAS by construction (observed layer-mean **0.875 = 0.875**, best **1.0 = 1.0**, McNemar **p = 1.0**, 0 discordant pairs). The lever is NOT settled. It requires the **Condition-3 blind-rater instrument** or independently-annotated rival labels that cross-cut the domain partition — not a relabeling probe.

**2. THE WELD — diagnosed axis → corrected notation → live steering lever, as one machine. NARROWED 2026-08-19; half of it now exists.**
This is the whole of Claim B's second half, and it is the difference between "the scanner names the axis" and "the system corrects the fault." **The links exist; the weld does not** — that sentence still stands for the machine as a whole, and the 2026-08-19 narrowing below says exactly which link is now welded and which are not.
**What is now BUILT and measured (Cap. 37, commit `2c5bb083`):** `INJECT → blind GATE → blind LOCALIZE → chained REPAIR → blind VERIFY`, on **axis `A` (Pathway/RPM) on the numeric plane only**, with blindness enforced by `inspect.signature`, the corrector's input `is`-checked against the localizer's output, a chance null of **1/7 = 0.142857** that a random intervention empirically hits at **0.149000**, and a tamper check showing the outcome flips when ground truth drives the corrector instead. **Three of six cases are designed to fail and do**, including mislocalization propagating to correction failure.
**What is still ABSENT, and this is the whole remaining frontier:** `J1` (model output text → CAS), `J2` (corrected expression → epsilon prefix), the return leg, and **Stage 5 — any measurement on any model.** **No efficacy claim exists. Nothing in the weld track bears on whether CAS correction improves a model's behaviour.** Axes `N`/`W`/`F`/`E`/`S`/`P` remain out of scope on the numeric plane, and `invert_expression(src,'A')` still raises `DeferredAxisError` on the string plane.
**Wording change on the record, so the negative is not quietly softened:** this frontier previously read *"No auto axis→repair dispatcher exists anywhere."* **As of 2026-08-19 the word "anywhere" is FALSE and only that word changed** — one exists, for one axis, on the numeric plane. The unqualified sentence is retained verbatim, with its narrowing, at §5.2 item 14 and at Cap. 20 gap 3. **Nothing else about this frontier moved.**
**Would settle it:** an end-to-end run where a fault is detected on a named axis, the corrected notation is emitted **by code**, and a validated lever (η→ε prefix black-box, or drive-local eraser white-box) closes a measured Δ-I on that fault — with the intervention stopping when the delta is closed.

**3. L3 — matched-surface minimal pairs, built properly.**
The sharpest anti-thesaurus discriminator has **not been validly run**. Until it is, the L1/L2 positives rest on weaker discriminators than the design intended.
**Would settle it:** **role-swap pairs scored at the cause/effect level**, where surface is genuinely held constant, with `DECISIVE_readers_split_where_thesaurus_ties = TRUE`.

`control_proof` is PARTIAL at 20B on **both** axes, and on F28 at 20B **no text control at all** was run against the headline 86.862%. **Where a character control was run and lost, the claim was withdrawn** (W0, 2026-06-18). **This is a live risk, not a formality.**

**Would settle it:** the OLMo-1B arm at the same pass bar (win-share ≫ 50%, `p < 10⁻¹⁰`).

**13. Pre-speech detection.**
DATA-BLOCKED. Gated on a **more-refusing model** plus a per-step matched-pair recapture of **≥40 matched pairs** (currently `G_matched = 2`). Lyapunov and activation-lacunarity variants are **KILLED — no canonical estimator exists.**

**14. 40E lacunarity at 20B, and 20B weight-geometry replication.** Both on the roadmap, neither run.

**15. A raw artifact for the runtime verification stack.**
`87.6%` accept / `99.78%` accepted accuracy / `0.22%` silent error exist **only in a prose section** of `docs/legal_drafts_20260607/CAS_HARNESS_SPEC_SHEET_current.md` §5.13. They were never re-derived in the Gate-2 reconciliation pass, and the model scale is `unavailable`. Cap. 23 is therefore `NOT LICENSED`.
**Would settle it:** a run report on disk carrying seed, split, control arm, mode, and an **attributed model**, from which those three figures reproduce. Until then they may not be quoted as measurements.

**16. The stance-explicitness-matched non-CAS prefix control for the η→ε bridge.**
This is the **pre-registered control that was never run**, and it is the single reason Cap. 2 reads `REAL` + `PARTIAL` instead of `VALIDATED`. Without it, `+1.412050` is consistent with *"a fluent prefix naming the answer is attended."*
**Would settle it:** run the bridge with a non-CAS English prefix matched on stance-explicitness against the same frozen fixture, and report the delta whichever way it falls. **Related and separate:** re-run the 20B F28 bridge on the **nearest-centroid** readout with the strict full-loop gate pre-registered in advance, so the `+0.596413` no longer depends on a readout chosen after two misses (§7.12).

**17. THE BOARD TAXONOMY DOES NOT FIT NATURAL CONVERSATION. — NEW 2026-08-19, and it is the highest-value new frontier in this pass.**
On a natural-conversation corpus the six-code board taxonomy resolved to **two live categories**: consensus labels `B0 115`, `B3 40`, `B2 1`, `B5 1`, with **`B1` and `B4` never reaching consensus at all** and `B0` taking **0.7325** of the mass against a pre-registered **0.40** ceiling (§7.16). On the earlier, purpose-built corpus the same six codes spread evenly (`b0_share` **0.1915**, kappa **0.5444**). **So the codes are usable when the corpus is built to exercise them and collapse when it is not — which is a fit problem, and it blocks every sequential lens claim underneath it.** Note the direction of the danger: a taxonomy that always answers `B0` will look stable and agreeable in demos.
**Would settle it:** either (a) a corpus-independent demonstration that all six codes are recoverable at consensus on text nobody selected for them, or (b) an explicit, dated re-scoping of the taxonomy to the categories that survive, with the retired codes named. **Do not fix it by relaxing the `B0` share ceiling** — that ceiling is what detected the problem.

**18. RE-AUDIT EVERY PRIOR `run_inversion_scan` VERDICT ON A DRIVE-TAGGED EXPRESSION. — NEW 2026-08-19.**
Until commit `f799fe98`, axis `W` **could not fire** on any drive-tagged literal (§7.18), and axes `E` and `S` are unconditional placeholders — so the Python-side scan was **four of seven** on the shapes this project actually emits, while reporting `clean=True` with the plausible reason *"fewer than 2 domain markers"*. **Consumers affected: `belief_store.py`, `data/verifier.py`, `api/routes/mode7.py`. No re-audit has been run.**
**Would settle it:** re-run every stored or cited Python-side scan verdict on a drive-tagged expression under the fixed regex, and report which verdicts flip. Until that exists, `§5.2 item 29` binds: **a pre-`f799fe98` clean scan may not be cited.**

**19. `detect_pathway_inversion` MISSES A WHOLE CLASS OF GENUINE PREREQUISITE INVERSIONS. — NEW 2026-08-19.**
The guard opens only when the earlier stage falls **below 0.5**, so any real inversion whose unsatisfied stage stays **above** 0.5 is invisible. WELD v2's `NEG-1` injects exactly one — `A0` lowered to **0.55** while `D` stays at **0.80** — and the scanner reports clean, the chain stops, and the criteria record as `null` rather than as passes. **The loop surfaced this and left it open; it is a coverage hole in shipped detection code, not in an experiment.**
**Would settle it:** a decision on the guard — widen it, or document the floor as intended behaviour — plus regression cases at the boundary. **Note the honest tension: widening the guard changes what `axis A severity = violated_chains / 7` means, and every WELD v2 number is computed against the current rule.**

**20. A surface control for turn-type compliance.**
Recovery of a prescribed turn type ran at **0.7619** against **0.1429** chance (Cap. 34) — but **no char or word control was run**, so "the model complied" is not separated from "the model produced stylised text a word-counter also recognises". A model told to write a `PLAN` may emit a numbered list.
**Would settle it:** the char-ngram and word-unigram arms against the **prescribed-type** task, reported whichever way they fall. **This is the same char-level gate that withdrew the W0 licence in 2026-06-18 (§7.11); it is permanent and it applies here.**

### 10.1 Do NOT re-run these — settled negatives

- Coarse **global** activation steering on the `^2−^3` polarity axis (`FALSIFIED`; random directions moved it more).
- Stage 27H prefix-plus-neuron steering (`NULL_NOT_ESTABLISHED`); Stage 27I prediction-position neuron steering (`NULL`); drive-subspace steering **without** the eraser channel (`NULL`, `p = 1.0`).
- Stage 6.6 / 7.3 / 7.OA / 7.LA ablation-based generation steering — **structurally impossible under section-retraction** (they try to invert ε).
- Noetic-axis steering (`NULL`, predicted in advance by the `Oscillatory` fractal class).
- **"More parts" for the L2 lens** — the 20-part widening was flat (+0.231 vs +0.210) and agreement **fell**.
- **"Use subspace ablation"** as the fix for Component Atlas AMP-F5 — **AMP-F5 already IS rank-1 projection removal.** It failed on **selectivity, not method-power**.
- **A second widening step** on the DR rail. One authorised step was spent (D50/D58), the 2.55× widening at 2.8b moved engagement by **exactly 0.00**, and an open-ended widen-until-it-moves search is **fishing and prohibited**.
- Patching a bank that failed an acceptance gate. **Reject-not-repair is binding.**
- **A Component Atlas rev 0.5 — at a larger scale, a wider cover, a different layer, or a rebuilt null.** Added 2026-08-19. All four were tried across rev 0.2 → 0.3 → 0.4; the one that mattered most (widening) moved DR engagement by **exactly 0.00** at 2.8b; and at 20B both sanity checks pass while the labels return nothing, so the result is **instrument-independent** (§6.7).
- **Next-board prediction on natural conversation.** Added 2026-08-19. Persistence beat the Markov predictor (**0.5238** vs **0.5079**) and the permutation null returned `p = 0.4279`. **Conversations are sticky; there is nothing to predict.** The question was already re-pointed at the transitions (§7.14, §7.16).
- **SDG-rendered text as a reading corpus, in any variant.** Added 2026-08-19. **38 distinct strings, surface accuracy 1.0000 on char, on word AND on raw character count**, and a rubric-derived answer key. *"The template pool IS the artifact."* Reviving it needs a different corpus **and** a non-circular key — **not a relaxed bar** (§7.15).
- **Any control that excludes the true item from its own pool.** Added 2026-08-19. That is WELD v1's fatal 1: the stated null `0.0256` was false and the real null was **exactly 0** (§7.17). **A control whose chance rate a random guess cannot hit is not a control.**

This sheet was assembled 2026-08-19 from the mined project record: the Gate-2 closure claims matrix and withdrawn-ACCEPT root cause, the original closure methodology, the Component Atlas prereg and all three run reports, the CAS-specificity and output-lens result documents, the operational runbooks and pod specs, and the legacy `CAS_HARNESS_SPEC_SHEET_current.md`. **Where the record disagreed with itself, both readings are recorded** (e.g. the Pythia-160M 40E `89.799%` vs `91.719%` conflict). **Where a fact is unrecoverable, it reads `unavailable`** and was not filled in.
